headers_missing.HSTS (Strict-Transport-Security): Forces browsers to use HTTPS. Prevents downgrade attacks.
headers_missing.Content-Security-Policy (CSP): Prevents XSS, clickjacking, and code injection.
headers_missing.X-Frame-Options: Prevents clickjacking by controlling iframe embedding.
headers_missing.Referrer-Policy: Controls how much referrer info is shared.
